title: The Digestive System
summary: From mouth to anus: how teeth, saliva, stomach acid, bile and enzymes break food down, and villi absorb it.

ib.note: Enzyme specificity and villi structure follow in MYP 4–5

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 9: Life Processes in Animals

objectives: I can name the parts of the digestive system in order and describe what happens in each.
I can explain why food must be digested before it is absorbed.
I can plan an experiment showing that saliva digests starch.
misconceptions: Digestion happens only in the stomach.
Food goes down by gravity alone.
